purpose: Bounded authoring and fresh-reader evaluations; fixture definitions do not claim execution.

cases.request: Create only the catalog-discovery feature planning package from the supplied SpoolIn sources. Preserve all project files and label this bounded scope.
inputs: design specification, discovery states and component contracts
techdoc frontend/query handoff and API contracts
ATDD-002, ATDD-256, ATDD-303 and relevant fixtures
evaluate: Feature-named directory and separate task files
Real versus controlled proof ownership
All applicable UI states and selected render contexts
No production test/evidence claims
Exact source references and dependency prerequisites

cases.request: Plan a small CLI negative-count validation fix using the supplied source and existing parser.
evaluate: One cohesive task is sufficient
No invented frontend, database or setup phase
Unit and actual CLI-boundary assertions
Fresh independent review still required

cases.request: Plan a producer/consumer contract change across two repositories with a shared generated output and integration fixture.
evaluate: Each repository has an explicit root
Contract precedes consumers
Shared writes/resources prevent unsafe concurrency
Real combined outcome has one verification owner

cases.request: Plan two independent behaviors where one has conflicting accepted limits and the other has complete source evidence.
evaluate: Affected behavior stays a precise gap
Independent work progresses
No silent source rewriting or guessed policy
Draft and execution state remain distinct

cases.request: Update a plan with a completed task after its governing acceptance rule changes.
evaluate: Task IDs and old evidence preserved
Impact disposition recorded
Affected task reopened and previous proof marked stale
Unaffected evidence is not described as newly executed

cases.request: Review a purportedly completed UI task whose real integration environment and independent reviewer were unavailable.
evaluate: No Done claim
Component evidence retains its proof boundary
Missing visual/integration/reviewer evidence identified
Specific resumable handoff

cases.request: Using only the generated entry point, group, task and explicit sources, identify the next eligible task and explain its implementation and verification without executing it.
evaluate: No authoring-chat dependency
Can find current instructions, prerequisites and intended change
Can identify expected outcomes and proof limits
Can explain completion and review gates

cases.request: Plan account storage, registration and browser acceptance when policy and receipts must intervene.
evaluate: Folder prefix equals group ID
Globally consecutive contiguous task ranges
All prerequisites have smaller task numbers
Split stages retain account feature label and verification ownership

cases.request: Renumber an active plan while another writer owns an unfinished selection.
evaluate: Idle acknowledgment precedes switch
Versioned source revision and simultaneous old/new ID/path mapping
Historical receipts and budgets preserved
Existing accepted status retained; unaccepted source stays unfinished

negative_triggers: Execute an already approved implementation task
Install or research planning skills without generating a project plan
